mechanism: Dolutegravir may chelate with divalent cations like calcium and magnesium, potentially affecting cholecalciferol absorption, and cholecalciferol can increase intestinal calcium absorption which may affect dolutegravir bioavailability if taken simultaneously.
action: Separate administration by at least 6 hours; cholecalciferol should be taken with meals while dolutegravir should be taken on an empty stomach or with food depending on formulation to minimize chelation effects.
